Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses NOTE :- i) Party shall furnish material test certificate from NABL accredited test lab and other certifica tes consist of: a) Chemical composition & Mechanical properties (TS, % elongation, hardness etc.).

b) Dimensional check report. c) Metallurgical test certificate (micro structural examination, grain size etc.). d) Heat treatment certificate (Heat treatment chart, hardness, case depth certificate). e) Ultrasonic test certificate as per class A (2) of IS: 8791. ii) Party shall furnish interchangeability certificate confirming that parts supplied shall be i nterchangeable with the one already in service on our XRS-603 Bowl Mill. iii) Annexure-I and II are enclosed for manufacturing & quality assurance. iv) Party shall submit copy of minimum one PO of worm wheel and worm shaft for Bowl Mill XRS-603/ 623 /XRP-623/ 703/ 763 / 783/ 803 / 963 successfully delivered in recent 10 years (fro m issuing date of this NIT) to any Fertilizer plant/ Thermal/electricity power plant/ Petrochemi cal plant/ Continuous chemical process plant/ EPC company. v) Party shall submit completion certificate from the end user. In case party is not able to su bmit completion certificate from the end user, then bidder shall submit self-certificate on com pany letter head confirming that delivery has been completed successfully against submitted PO along with documentary proof like Tax Invoice & bank account statement or IRN (Inspectio n release note) LR Copy . 4.
